# Packages this project declares, one name per line, consumed by
# lfreleng-actions/grype-scan-action as `declared-dependencies`.
#
# Why this file exists at all: the action would rather read the
# dependency graph out of our CycloneDX SBOM, but
# lfreleng-actions/python-sbom-action runs `cyclonedx-py environment`,
# which inventories the installed virtualenv rather than the project.
# The result carries no `metadata.component` root, so its dependency
# graph is unrooted; the action refuses such a graph, and an unusable
# source deliberately leaves every finding classified as declared --
# which gates on exactly the inherited packages we cannot fix. This
# list is the documented fallback, and `declared-source: file` names
# it explicitly rather than relying on the auto fallback.
#
# The list MUST be complete with respect to pyproject.toml: anything
# missing from it is classified as inherited and is therefore gated
# more leniently. Add an entry here whenever a dependency is added to
# pyproject.toml, in the same spelling the SBOM uses for it.
#
# Names, not purls, deliberately. A purl carries the resolved version,
# so a purl entry would stop matching the moment the version moved
# and would silently downgrade the package to inherited.

# The integration itself, as it appears in the SBOM.
guesty

# [project] dependencies -- shipped to users.
httpx

# [project.optional-dependencies] test and [dependency-groups] dev.
# Not shipped, but we do choose these versions, so a finding in one of
# them is ours to act on. homeassistant belongs here for the same
# reason: we cannot bump what Home Assistant pins behind it, but we do
# choose the Home Assistant floor, so the package itself is ours.
homeassistant
interrogate
mypy
pytest
pytest-asyncio
pytest-cov
pytest-homeassistant-custom-component
respx
ruff

# [build-system] requires.
hatch-vcs
hatchling
